regime_context: The Canada/TSX detector shows a broad, multi-theme precious-metals leadership structure without a single dominant narrative: Gold Miners lead (durability 0.85, breadth 1.0, eligible, not crowded) with Silver & Royalties challenging on a 0.552 margin. Rotation breadth is broad (14/16 eligible), and the absolute-trend gate is validated risk control on this market (gate_helps true). Momentum rank is a focus lens only; track record direction accuracy is 0.318, so conviction defaults low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Big Banks (rank 4, score 0.81, breadth only 0.429) can rebuild breadth above 0.6 while the precious-metals cluster loses its top-two grip; the condition that would retire this watch is a confirmed slip of Gold Miners out of the rank-1 slot for 5 consecutive sessions without Banks climbing above rank 3.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners hold the strongest combination of trend-gate eligibility (durability 0.85, hurst_tag 'trend') and cohesion (breadth 1.0), with crowding_z 0.95 just below the crowded flag. As the leader with high durability and full breadth, it is the least fragile leg for a trend-following, vol-aware lean; the validated absolute-trend gate supports staying with the existing highest-durability trend rather than rotating out.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are highly sensitive to the gold price itself, which can mean-revert sharply on any macro surprise (e.g., an inflation read or real-rate move); the momentum rank itself carries no forward return edge on clean sectors.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO falls below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days before the 30-day check.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: The challenger theme is eligible and trend-adjacent (durability 0.77, hurst_tag 'mixed') with breadth 1.0 and a 0.552 margin behind Gold Miners. It is not crowded (crowding_z 0.9). As the second leg of a broad precious-metals leadership structure, it is a reasonable continuation lean while the precious-metals group holds the top of the ranks; this is conditional on the group remaining the dominant leadership cluster, not a separate prediction.
theses.dissent: Silver is more industrially exposed than gold and can lag gold miners when industrial demand softens; 'mixed' trend health is weaker than Gold Miners' clean 'trend' tag.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO proxy for Silver & Royalties lags XGD.TO (Gold Miners proxy) by more than 5% over any rolling 10-day window before the 21-day check.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is the only crowded theme in the top ranks (crowding_z 1.23, crowded true) while carrying a 'mixed' trend tag and lower durability (0.76). Under the guardrails, crowding is a sizing caution and a reason to be underweight relative to the cleaner leaders, not a fade or short. The lean is expressed as a relative caution flag, not a directional certainty.
evidence: guardrails: crowding only DOWN-SIZES, never fades or shorts
theses.dissent: Copper can have genuine secular supply-demand tailwinds independent of positioning, and crowded doesn't mean top; the theme could keep trending if global capex demand surprises.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO outperforms the S&P/TSX by 3% over the next 21 trading days despite the crowded flag.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
